background: UBS Group is Switzerland's only remaining global bank after absorbing Credit Suisse, the world's largest wealth manager, with Swiss retail and corporate banking, asset management and an investment bank, and a balance sheet far larger than the Swiss economy.
synthesis: Rated A on average across two of the three, the weakest of them at A-, both on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 14 Apr 2026, UBS holds a solid single-A standing. CET1 is 14.4% and leverage 5.8%, with LCR of 177% and NSFR of 115%, and none of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Jun 2026. The issue to watch is regulatory: the flagged news, the newest on 2 Oct 2026, centres on Swiss proposals for higher capital requirements and their cost to the group.
